Calculate pi, theta, and D statistics

Source: R/pi_theta_d_stats.R
pi_theta_d_stats.Rd

This function calculates pi, Watterson's theta, and Tajima's D for specified sites within genetic groups following the methods in Pixy, which accounts for missing data to produce unbiased estimates. For further details see https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/1755-0998.13326 and https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/1755-0998.14104 . Data is filtered based on genetic group (minimum number of loci, minimum minor allele frequency, and maximum missingness per locus) and minimum number of individuals per site.

Usage

pi_theta_d_stats(
  gt,
  genetic_group_variable,
  site_variable,
  n = NULL,
  minimum_n = 5,
  minimum_loci = 5,
  max_missingness = 0.1,
  maf = 0,
  allele_count_min = 0
)

Arguments

gt

Genotype matrix where individuals are rows and loci are columns, coded as 0=aa, 1=aA, 2=AA.

genetic_group_variable

Vector of genetic group IDs for each individual (same length as number of rows in gt). Can represent species, subspecies, or other biologically relevant structure groups.

site_variable

Vector of group IDs (sites) for each individual (same length as number of rows in gt).

n

Number of individuals to use for calculations per site. If left as NULL, all individuals are used.

minimum_n

Minimum number of individuals required per site (sites with fewer individuals will be filtered out).

minimum_loci

Minimum number of loci required to proceed with analysis for each genetic group (genetic groups with fewer loci will be skipped).

max_missingness

Maximum proportion of missing data allowed per locus (loci with higher missingness will be filtered out).

maf

Minimum minor allele frequency filter.

allele_count_min

Minimum minor allele count to keep a locus, can be used to exclude singletons.

Value

A data frame with the following columns:

group

Genetic group ID (e.g., species, subspecies).

site

Site ID corresponding to the sample location.

loci

Number of loci used in the analysis for that group-site combination.

n

Number of individuals sampled at the site for the given group.

pi

Nucleotide diversity summed over segregating sites.

S

Number of segregating sites.

theta

Watterson's theta summed over segregating sites.

D

Tajima's D statistic.

real_missingness

Proportion of missing data in the filtered genotype matrix.

Details

Monomorphic and invariant sites. Monomorphic sites are excluded, and pi and theta are sums over segregating sites rather than per-site (per-nucleotide) values. Per-site estimates require the number of invariant sites sequenced, which is unavailable for many reduced-representation datasets (such as DArTseq SNP reports); monomorphic SNP loci alone do not provide it. pi and theta therefore scale with the number of loci analysed, and are comparable among sites analysed with the same loci, not with genome-wide nucleotide diversity estimates. Tajima's D does not depend on invariant sites. See calculate_pi_theta_d.

See also

[resampling_individuals_CI(), resampling_loci_CI()]
